description: This file implements executor mappers and executor pools for CU-UP (Control and User Plane) in a 5G network context, including classes for decorating executors, round-robin executor pools, and strand-based executor mappers with detailed configuration and creation methods.

classes.name: executor_decorator
classes.description: Helper class to decorate executors with additional functionalities such as tracing, throttling, and metrics.

classes.name: ue_executor_mapper_impl
classes.description: Implementation of the UE executor mapper, managing control, UL, DL, and crypto executors.

classes.name: base_cu_up_executor_pool_config
classes.description: Configuration structure for CU-UP executor pools, including executors, timers, and tracing options.

classes.name: round_robin_cu_up_exec_pool
classes.description: Manages a pool of UE executors with round-robin dispatch, supporting creation of UE executor mappers.

classes.name: strand_based_cu_up_executor_mapper
classes.description: Strand-based executor mapper for CU-UP, supporting sequential execution and creation of UE mappers.

methods.name: make_cu_up_executor_mapper
methods.description: Factory function to create a strand-based CU-UP executor mapper based on provided configuration.
